guardianConsent.title: Guardian consent
guardianConsent.intro: Choose how {child}’s work may be shared for {competition} at {institution}.
guardianConsent.sendHint: We’ll send a one-time code to {contact}.
guardianConsent.codeHint: Enter the six-digit code sent to {contact}.
guardianConsent.answerHint: Choose one answer for each use. Save your choices by <deadline>{answerBy}</deadline>.

done.title: Your choices have been saved
done.body: Thank you. To change a choice, ask your school for a new consent link.

used.title: This link has already been used
used.body: Ask your school for a new link if you want to change your choices.

expired.title: This consent link has expired
expired.body: Ask your school for a new link.

revoked.title: This consent link was withdrawn
revoked.body: Contact your school if you need a new link.

not_found.title: Consent link unavailable
not_found.body: Check the link in your message or ask your school for help.

errors.not_found: Check the link in your message or ask your school for help.
errors.already_used: This link has already been used.
errors.expired: This consent link has expired. Ask your school for a new link.
errors.wait: You can request another code at {retryTime}.
errors.rate_limited: Too many code requests. Try again at {retryTime}.
errors.too_many_codes: This link has reached its code limit. Ask your school for a new link.
errors.sms_disabled: Texts are unavailable. Ask your school for an email link.
errors.delivery_failed: We couldn’t deliver a code. Check with your school or request another code in a minute.
errors.code_expired: This code has expired or has already been used. Request a new code.
errors.code_locked: This code is locked. Request a new code.
errors.invalid_code: Enter the six-digit code and try again.
errors.wrong_code: That code didn’t match. {attemptsLeft, plural, =0 {Request a new code.} one {# attempt left.} other {# attempts left.}}
errors.not_verified: Verify with a new code before saving your choices.
errors.window_closed: Your answer window ended. Request a new code to continue.
errors.stale_request: The consent choices for this competition have changed. Ask your school for a new link.
errors.save_failed: We couldn’t save your choices. Please try again.
errors.nothing_offered: There are no public-use choices on this link.
errors.unanswered: Choose an answer for each use before saving.
errors.not_offered: This link includes different choices. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalid_answer: Choose an answer for each use and try again.
